title: kith-jmap: ResultReference resolver ignores name field
description: kith-jmap/src/lib.rs — resolve_args() looks up by resultOf call-id only, ignores the name field. RFC 8620 §9 says SHOULD return invalidArguments if name doesn't match the referenced invocation. No security impact (client controls both call-id and path), but it is a spec conformance gap that a future JMAP test suite would flag. Fix: after finding prior response by call-id, verify its method name matches the ResultReference name field.
